New commentary and updates to enlightening interviews with today's top global macro hedge fund managers
This updated paperback edition of Inside the House of Money lifts the veil on the typically opaque world of hedge funds offering a rare glimpse at how today's highest paid money managers approach their craft. Now with new commentary, author, Steve Drobny takes you even further into the hedge fund industry.

Steven Drobny is the founder and CEO of Drobny Global Asset Management, an independent investment advisory, asset management and consulting firm focused on global macro and commodity hedge fund strategies. He is also the author of The Invisible Hands: Top Hedge Fund Traders on Bubbles, Crashes, and Real Money (Wiley). Mr. Drobny holds an MSc in finance and accounting from the London School of Economics and Political Science and a BS/BA from Bucknell University.
